description: A full-frame animated backdrop for an explainer stretch, in the same desk language as the rest of the packs. Choose whether it goes behind you, shrinks you into a window on it, or replaces the shot entirely.

fields.name: framing
fields.label: Framing
fields.description: behind: the backdrop replaces the room and you stay live and full size (needs the subject matte). pip: the backdrop takes the frame and you shrink into a window on it. solo: backdrop only, no camera.

fields.name: style
fields.label: Backdrop
fields.description: grid: drifting notebook ruling. grain: warm paper with moving light. gradient: a slow ink wash. shapes: sparse torn-paper shapes floating up.

fields.name: intensity
fields.label: Intensity
fields.description: How present the backdrop is. Lower it when there is a lot of text on top.
